convert_dataset_to_parquet: convert a HuggingFace dataset config to parquet files and commit them to the Hub
copy_parquet_files: copy existing parquet files from a dataset builder and generate commit operations
stream_convert_to_parquet: stream convert a dataset to parquet files with a max size limit to avoid timeouts
fill_builder_info: fill a dataset builder info by reading metadata from copied parquet files
create_commits: create one or more commits on the HuggingFace Hub with batched file operations
